newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Iberia had 1.22 bln pta profit in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Spain Iberia had 1.22 bln pta profit in Jan-May.

text.p: Spain's state owned airline company Iberia said on Thursday during the first five months of the year it had net profit of 1.22 billion pesetas versus a loss of 5.02 billion pesetas loss in the same period a year ago.
The statement said it was the first time in the recent history of Iberia that the airline has made a net profit in this period of the year.
In April, Iberia announced it had 1.5 billion pesetas net profit for the month of March.
According to the statement, the improvement was due to solving problems in Latin America and to a more aggressive commercial policy.
The total number of passengers rose in the period 12.5 percent, while the passenger load factor was 72.2 percent, up 4.5 points.

But the statement added that the Iberia chairman Xabier de Irala said that "operating profit, stood at 4.0 billion pesetas, but was lower than the one of the previous year due to a strong rise in expenditures."
